title: I Hid From the Best Seeker on Earth 😳
logline: Bloxy plays hide and seek against Dot, who has never lost, and finds out why she always wins.

story.premise: First-person hide and seek against the best seeker on Earth: seven-year-old Dot, never beaten.
story.conflict: Dot finds Bloxy in seconds every round, wherever he hides, without even looking.
story.stakes: Bloxy has lost 400 times in a row; one more loss and the streak is official forever.
story.reveal: Dot finds him because Bloxy narrates everything out loud, including this video.
story.ending: Bloxy realises she can hear the narration right now and whispers a rematch.

hook.question: How does Dot always find him?

payoff.text: Dot always wins because Bloxy narrates every move out loud, so she can hear this too.

setting.description: A moonlit block forest with a campfire; three hiding spots: a big tree, a low rock and a tree deep in the woods.

beats.description: Bloxy sprints for the big tree in a panic while Dot counts with her hand over her eyes.
Dot counts at the campfire. 400 losses in a row.
Round one: Dot finds Bloxy in two seconds, eyes still covered.
Round two: Bloxy lies flat behind a rock; Dot strolls over.
Round three: Bloxy runs deep into the trees and sits in a hole he dug.
Bloxy looks straight at the camera from his hole, deadpan.
Final round: Bloxy freezes in plain sight. No blinking, no breathing.
Dot explains how: Bloxy narrates everything out loud.
Bloxy realises she can hear this right now.
Bloxy whispers the rematch; it runs straight back into the opening line.

title: I Fell Over Every Time Someone Said Hi 😳

title: I Lost My Best Friend's Birthday Gift 😳
logline: Five minutes before Pip's party, Bloxy cannot find the present, and everyone can see it but him.

story.ending: Pip liked the old tooth more, and now Bloxy cannot find the tooth.

payoff.text: The present was in Bloxy's own hand the whole time, and Pip liked the old tooth more.

Pip points at Bloxy's hand: the present was there all morning.
Pip liked the old tooth more.
Now Bloxy cannot find the tooth.

title: I Skipped Every Monday for a Whole Year 😳
